text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Wholesale prices of all beef grades have gone up by 22 percent with effect from Monday as the state-owned Cold Storage Company battles to attract more cattle to its abattoirs ahead of the Christmas period and in the face of a general shortage of slaughter stock.

- The Zimbabwe government will have to acquire 4.5 million hectares of land from large-scale commercial farmers in the next few years to resettle thousands of landless people, Lands and Water Resources minister Kumbirai Kangai said at the weekend.
